title: 🧭 Identity, Market and the League Map
notes: 🧭 Research → Outlook opens with your Team Identity: a Win now score and a Future score, and what the data says you are (All-in, Contend, On the fence, Retool or Rebuild).
🎚️ Pick your own approach. It steers Moves, Market and the Trade Finder, and it's saved on your device only.

📉 Research → Market: buy-low targets across the league, sell-high candidates on your roster, and a fade list. Each one comes with reasons: TD luck, usage trends, age, value moves and whether the owner is likely to sell.
🌌 Research → League: a map of every team (win now vs. future) plus each team's needs, strengths and picks. Tap Find trades for fair deals with any team.
🃏 Player cards now show league context: who owns the player, whether they're a likely seller, buy-low or sell-high scores, and which teams are thin at that position.
📊 Playoff odds now use each lineup's rest-of-season projection.
